title: 联合子空间稀疏注意力：高效长上下文解码
summary: 提出联合子空间稀疏注意力（JSSA），通过学习共享低维查询-键子空间提升token级选择质量，并设计无gather的索引注意力内核。在GQA、MLA等模型上保持接近全KV精度，128K上下文下解码吞吐量提升至6.43倍。
summary_en: Introduces Joint Subspace Sparse Attention (JSSA), which learns a shared low-dimensional query-key subspace for better token-level selection and develops a gather-free indexed-attention kernel. It stays close to full-KV accuracy across GQA, MLA, and hybrid attention models, achieving up to 6.43x decoding throughput at 128K context.
